Contract Generator.contract:
Contract GenerateLoanLetterAndAgreementModule::genereateApprovalLetter(id: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		obs: LoanRequest = LoanRequest.allInstance()->any(o|o.RequestID = id)
	precondition:
		obs.oclIsUndefined() = false
	postcondition:
		let approvalLetter: ApprovalLetter in
		approvalLetter.oclIsNew() and
		approvalLetter.Content = "ApprovalLetterContent" and
		obs.AttachedApprovalLetter->includes(approvalLetter) and
		CurrentLoanRequest = obs and
		CurrentApprovalLetter = approvalLetter and
		result = true
}
